Commuter100Block-149730.description: This plan is open to students who live in off-campus housing. The Commuter 100 block plan allows 100 punches per semester at either our all-you-care-to-eat residential dining rooms, or retail establishments (retail location punches limited to 2x per day). This plan comes with $350 Dining Dollars per semester to use at all dining locations. The price reflected is the per semester rate. This meal plan is an annual contract billed over two semesters. You will be charged once in the fall and again in the spring.
Commuter100Block-149730.name: Non-Resident 100 Block
Commuter100Block-149730.additional_info: Unused Dining Dollars expire at the end of the semester. This plan can be billed to tuition, or pay be cash, check, credit card, or FLEX.
Commuter100Block-149730.extra_info: Meals should be used weekly during the semester

Commuter10Punch-149727.description: This plan is open to students who live in off-campus housing. The Commuter 10 punch plan allows up to 10 punches per week at either our all-you-care-to-eat residential dining rooms, or retail establishments (limited to retail punches 2x per day). This plan comes with $275 Dining Dollars per semester to use at all dining locations. Enjoy 5 guest meals so that you can bring your visiting friends and family to dine with you! You may use 2 meal punches per day in select retail locations on campus. The price reflected is the per semester rate. This meal plan is an annual contract billed over two semesters. You will be charged once in the fall and again in the spring.
Commuter10Punch-149727.name: Non-Resident 10 Punch
Commuter10Punch-149727.additional_info: Unused Dining Dollars end of the semester. Meals reset on Sunday. This plan can be billed to tuition, or pay by cash, check, credit card, or FLEX.
Commuter10Punch-149727.extra_info: Meals should be used weekly during the semester
Commuter10Punch-149727.guest_punches: 5 Guest Meals to share with your friends
